unit: meters per artist unit, source-scene frame before Avatar restPose and motion

neck.centerRule: arithmetic mean of these unique source POSITION rows, no compacting or closest-surface inference

hem.centerRule: arithmetic mean of these unique source POSITION rows, no compacting or closest-surface inference

negative-X-cuff.centerRule: arithmetic mean of these unique source POSITION rows, no compacting or closest-surface inference

positive-X-cuff.centerRule: arithmetic mean of these unique source POSITION rows, no compacting or closest-surface inference

transformConvention.rotation: identity in glTF scene-global axes; artist +Y and +Z interpreted as up/front by explicit choice
transformConvention.scaleRule: (target neck Y - target hem Y) / (source neck mean Y - source hem mean Y)
transformConvention.translationRule: target neck minus scale times source neck mean; hem depth and cuffs are independent held-out witnesses
transformConvention.policy: These are artist proposal choices, not measured human garment dimensions. No automatic adjustment on mismatch, no transformed mesh output or warp.

bodyAuthority: Unique morph-target-bearing skinned primitive owner selected by declared default scene traversal, as Figure.buildMorphRegistry does; retain exact node/mesh/primitive/accessor/skin ordinals. Fail ambiguity rather than choose by guessed mesh label.
referenceFoundation: Ink-selected upper bra only; retain full original scene/node/accessor descriptors and source POSITION arrays; compare named rig origins as source-frame witnesses only
open: joint origins as actual body-contact or garment surface constraints
runtime restPose, stage transforms, morphs and moving skin positions
physical cloth, tailored dimensions, relaxed worn geometry and appearance acceptance
decision: Reader may report observed frame/landmarks only after exact source admission. Mapping arithmetic and all-vertex warp are not admitted here; this editable numeric convention seeds a later independent decision.
